provenance.artifact: Linux Bedrock Dedicated Server 1.26.52.3 (bedrock_server, minecraft.net), run on our own machine with server-authoritative-movement-strict=true, player-position-acceptance-threshold=0.0001, online-mode=false; states read through its Script API after a headless client placed each block
notes: each block was placed with an InventoryTransaction UseItem (ClickBlock) carrying the clicked block's runtime id; its stored states were read back on the same server through the Script API (Block.permutation.getAllStates)
the player's feet come from the server's own position (eye − 1.62), after it settled on what it stood on

definition: with feet = the player's feet y, Y = the placed cell's y, and dx, dz = the feet's offsets from the cell's centre:
faces by feet_above when feet − Y > a and max(|dx|, |dz|) ≤ L
faces by cell_above when feet − Y < b and max(|dx|, |dz|) ≤ L
otherwise faces by yaw, as in horizontal; pitch does not enter

not_covered: the click height where stairs switch to upside down (only 0.25 and 0.75 tried)
the yaw boundaries between the four horizontal directions (only 0, 90, 180, −90)
the horizontal-only blocks placed with the player above the cell
